problems.note: Figure 8(a) visibly includes shaded bands around the AI and No AI performance curves. The displayed variability therefore concerns classifier-performance scores on sets, not independent participants. Under the extraction-spec definition, not_reported means no uncertainty is reported; absence of printed numerical bounds does not justify that code when variability is plotted. Use set. Keep the numerical uncertainty fields null: the band type, confidence level, and numerical bounds are not stated, and must not be inferred from the plot.

summary: Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-C, and checked every estimate source against the cited PDF pages. All recorded statistical values, signs, scales, and participant counts match the paper and belong to the stated analyses. The study and arm counts agree with Table 1 and Section 4. The numeric similarity analysis uses essay pairs; the numeric classifier analyses use sets of essays. Two figure-only embedding-ablation records incorrectly code their plotted variability as not_reported; their numerical uncertainty must remain null because the bands are not numerically or statistically defined. The remaining requested coding fields are supported. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found under extraction-spec rules 4-6; country subgroup, moderation, process, self-report, and illustrative content analyses are appropriately excluded.
